title: 2nd Stopping Place 4th Truth Unity In Beings And The Proclamation Of Divine Unity

questions.question: What do all created things show by the way they exist and appear?
questions.answer: They show that Allah is One.

questions.question: How can things be together but still be different from each other?
questions.answer: They can belong to one world but each one still has its own special form.

questions.question: What does it mean that some things are like small or big versions of other things?
questions.answer: It means they match in pattern even if their size is different.

questions.question: What are the two groups named in the passage: large groups and single members?
questions.answer: Kinds and species are the large groups, and individuals are the single members.

questions.question: What do similar natural patterns in living things help people understand?
questions.answer: They help people understand that one Maker made them.

questions.question: What do similar signs of art in things teach us?
questions.answer: They teach us that the same Creator designed them.

questions.question: How do things help one another in their jobs in creation?
questions.answer: They support and complete each other.

questions.question: What does all this teamwork in creation prove?
questions.answer: It proves the unity of their Maker.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the whole universe?
questions.answer: It is one complete whole, not broken into separate owners.

questions.question: According to the verse, how easy are creating people and raising them again for Allah?
questions.answer: It is as easy as creating and raising one soul.

questions.question: What is the main truth taught in this passage?
questions.answer: All beings clearly point to the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: Why does likeness between many created things matter?
questions.answer: It shows one plan and one Maker.

questions.question: If things can be both joined in one world and also each be separate, what does that suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests wise order from one Creator.

questions.question: What does it mean when some things are general groups and some are single examples?
questions.answer: It means creation has levels, from big kinds to one-by-one members.

questions.question: Why is it important that many things share the same built-in pattern?
questions.answer: Because shared patterns point to one Designer.

questions.question: What does it mean that things have similar marks of art?
questions.answer: They carry signs of the same beautiful making.

questions.question: Why is the helping of one thing by another important in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that creation works together under one rule.

questions.question: What does the passage say these signs establish about the Maker?
questions.answer: They establish that the Maker is one.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s care over the universe?
questions.answer: His care covers the whole universe as one complete order.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the verse at the end?
questions.answer: Allah can create and bring back everyone as easily as one person.

questions.question: Who is being pointed to by the many signs in all beings?
questions.answer: Allah, the one Maker.

questions.question: Name one kind of sign in the passage that points to Allah’s unity.
questions.answer: Many things resemble each other.

questions.question: Name another sign in the passage that points to Allah’s unity.
questions.answer: Some things are like smaller or larger forms of others.

questions.question: What do groups, kinds, and single living things together show?
questions.answer: They show one connected system of creation.

questions.question: If living things have similar built-in traits, what can we understand?
questions.answer: We can understand they come from one Creator.

questions.question: What can we learn from the beauty and design seen in many things?
questions.answer: One Maker gave them their design.

questions.question: What does it show when created things support one another in their work?
questions.answer: It shows harmony and one ruling plan.

questions.question: Does the passage describe the universe as split apart or joined as one whole?
questions.answer: Joined as one whole.

questions.question: Why can the universe not be divided into separate parts with separate rulers, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because its parts are linked together under one dominion.

questions.question: In the verse, what comparison is made about all people being created and raised again?
questions.answer: It is compared to one single soul.

questions.question: What do the many shared features of created things loudly tell us?
questions.answer: They tell us that Allah is One.

questions.question: What is one example of a shared feature named in the passage?
questions.answer: Many things are alike in some ways.

questions.question: What is another shared feature named in the passage?
questions.answer: Some are small forms or large forms of others.

questions.question: How are species and individuals different?
questions.answer: A species is a whole kind, and an individual is one member of that kind.

questions.question: Why would similar qualities in many creatures be a clue for us?
questions.answer: Because one Maker can give them matching qualities.

questions.question: What does similar workmanship in creation point to?
questions.answer: It points to one Artist.

questions.question: What does it mean that created things complete one another in their duties?
questions.answer: Each one has a part, and together they serve a bigger plan.

questions.question: What do all these clues together confirm?
questions.answer: They confirm the unity of the Creator.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the cosmos as a whole?
questions.answer: It is one undivided whole.

questions.question: What does the verse teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Bringing everyone into being and bringing them back is easy for Him.

questions.question: What truth about Allah is shown by all beings in the passage?
questions.answer: His oneness.

questions.question: Why does the passage talk about many points of sameness and connection?
questions.answer: To show that creation comes from one source.

questions.question: How can things be alike and still each be special?
questions.answer: They share a common pattern, but each has its own place and form.

questions.question: What can we notice when one thing seems like a tiny copy or a bigger version of another?
questions.answer: We can notice one plan in both.

questions.question: What do larger groups and smaller single members show when we think about them together?
questions.answer: They show order across all levels of creation.

questions.question: What does a shared built-in nature among creatures teach?
questions.answer: It teaches that one Maker gave them that nature.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention art and design in things?
questions.answer: To show the work of one Creator.

questions.question: What can we learn from the way created things help each other?
questions.answer: We learn that they are arranged to work together.

questions.question: What does this arrangement say about the universe?
questions.answer: It is one complete creation, not a broken collection.

questions.question: How does the verse help us understand resurrection?
questions.answer: It teaches that bringing all back to life is easy for Allah, like one life.

questions.question: What do the beings in the world clearly announce by their existence?
questions.answer: They announce Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What does the passage say about things being united and also distinct?
questions.answer: They are connected in one creation, but each is still separate and unique.

questions.question: Why is resemblance between things an important clue?
questions.answer: It points to one Maker.

questions.question: What does it mean when one thing is a small sample and another is a larger sample?
questions.answer: They reflect a similar design at different sizes.

questions.question: How do kinds and single members help us think about creation?
questions.answer: They show that the same order reaches both groups and individuals.

questions.question: What do similar inner patterns in created things suggest?
questions.answer: They suggest one wise Creator.

questions.question: What do matching signs of craftsmanship suggest?
questions.answer: They suggest one Artist made them.

questions.question: What does the helping and supporting among created things tell us?
questions.answer: It tells us they are working within one system.

questions.question: What is taught about the dominion over the cosmos?
questions.answer: It belongs to one Lord, so the cosmos is one whole.

questions.question: What simple meaning of the verse fits this passage?
questions.answer: For Allah, creating all people and raising them again is like doing it for one single soul.
